column1: # eyg-surface - the surface this tool prints: one row per builtin, one row per effect.
# Generated by bin/agent/gen-surface.mjs. Do not edit rows by hand; edit the inputs.
# effects: generated from test/fixtures/rule_mapping.gleam, the runtime's rule_mapping
#   recorded verbatim (test/fixtures/rule_mapping.PROVENANCE.md: where it came from, its
#   checksums, how to refresh it). `none` in the field column marks an effect no policy
#   can forbid. The language's page on CLI effects,
#   <https://eyg.run/guides/cli-effects-reference>, explains what each effect does; the
#   syntax prose is <https://eyg.run/guides/eyg-syntax-guide>. This package copies no
#   prose page: this file is the whole offline surface, and the compiler is the source
# builtins: names and signatures from the language's builtins page,
#   <https://eyg.run/guides/builtins-reference>; the names are the page's, not this package's. When that capture
#   was taken, and the checksum of the page text it came from, are recorded in
#   test/fixtures/surface.PROVENANCE.md - this file carries no date, because a row here
#   is current when --check below passes and drift when it does not. Re-capture with:
# drift: node bin/agent/gen-surface.mjs --check re-derives the effect rows from that
#   fixture, requires them to equal POLICY_FIELDS in lib/render-helpers.mjs, requires every
#   !builtin this tree's own .eyg sources call to be listed here, and compares the file
#   byte for byte with what it rebuilds. Offline, under a second.

column4: `((self) -> self) -> self`, where `self` is `(a) -> b` | Y-combinator. Use for self-recursive closures. The constructor is passed the function it builds, so it has to return a function.
`(String) -> Ok(Int) | Error({})` | Returns `Error({})` on bad input.
`(String, String) -> {head: String, tail: List(String)}` | Note the record shape: `head` is the first piece, `tail` is the rest as a flat list.
`(String, String) -> Ok({pre: String, post: String}) | Error({})` | Splits on first occurrence; `Error({})` if the separator is absent.
`(Binary) -> Ok(String) | Error({})` | UTF-8 decode; `Error({})` if the binary isn't valid UTF-8.
`(List(a)) -> Ok({head: a, tail: List(a)} | Error({})` | `Error({})` for the empty list.
`(List(a), b, (a, b) -> b) -> b` | Standard left-fold. Base for all recursive primitives such as map and each
`(Binary, Binary) -> Lt({}) | Eq({}) | Gt({})` | Byte-wise comparison.
`(Binary, b, (Int, b) -> b) -> b` | Byte-by-byte left fold.
